eyebrow.zh: 为每个 span 输出 proceed、abstain 或 handoff，保留探针证据与判定理由。
eyebrow.en: Produce proceed, abstain or handoff for each span, retaining probe evidence and the decision rationale.

headline.zh: 把不确定度与探针结果放在一起判断。

sub.zh: 为每个 span 输出 proceed、abstain 或 handoff，保留探针证据与判定理由。
sub.en: Produce proceed, abstain or handoff for each span, retaining probe evidence and the decision rationale.

caption.zh: 图示展示组件关系；实际输出见下方示例。
caption.en: An illustrative component scene; recorded output appears below.

body.zh: 返回探针证据和触发条件。
body.en: Return probe evidence and trigger conditions.

body.zh: 三态避免把所有标记都等同拦截。
body.en: Three states distinguish flags from handoffs.

body.zh: 同步与异步入口可由调用方接管。
body.en: Synchronous and asynchronous callers own the response.

body.zh: 一个步骤可能语法错误却自信，也可能只是模型表达犹豫。ProbeGate 把不确定度和可执行检查拆成两个信号，明确展示当前策略如何处理它们，方便 Agent 调用方决定继续、标记或请求人工。
body.en: A step may be syntactically wrong yet confident, or merely express uncertainty. ProbeGate separates uncertainty from machine-checkable evidence and makes the handling policy explicit so an agent caller can continue, flag or request human review.

body.zh: 四个合成 span 显式给定 0.1/0.9 不确定度和有效/无效 Python，执行真实 compile 探针并检查 AND 判定。不是实际模型置信校准实验。
body.en: Four synthetic spans explicitly supply uncertainty 0.1/0.9 and valid/invalid Python. The real compile probe exercises the AND policy; this is not a live-model calibration experiment.

alt.zh: 四个合成 span 显式给定 0.1/0.9 不确定度和有效/无效 Python，执行真实 compile 探针并检查 AND 判定。不是实际模型置信校准实验。
alt.en: Four synthetic spans explicitly supply uncertainty 0.1/0.9 and valid/invalid Python. The real compile probe exercises the AND policy; this is not a live-model calibration experiment.

body.zh: guard/guard_async 读取或从端点获取 uncertainty，调用所选 Probe，然后构造 GateDecision。仅当 uncertainty > threshold 且探针失败时 handoff；单信号触发为 abstain，双清为 proceed。返回值本身不停止调用方的 Agent。
body.en: guard/guard_async reads uncertainty or fetches it from an endpoint, runs the selected Probe and constructs GateDecision. handoff requires uncertainty > threshold and a failed probe. One signal produces abstain; neither produces proceed. Returning a decision does not itself stop the caller’s agent.

body.zh: CLI 和 Python API 使用同一套决策模型，UI 可展示逐 span 决策。compile 只做 Python 编译而不运行代码；其他探针有各自输入契约，应在接入前阅读对应模块。
body.en: CLI and Python API share decision models, and the UI can display per-span decisions. compile byte-compiles Python without running it; other probes have their own input contracts to inspect before integration.

body.en: CLI and Python API share decision models, and the UI can display per-span decisions. compile byte-compiles Python without running it; other probes have their own input contracts to inspect before integration.

body.zh: `.probegate.toml` 管理 uncertainty_threshold、probe、model_target、handoff_mode、api_key 与 base_url。默认 threshold=0.5，probe=compile。提供 key 与 URL 后可获取 logprob 信号；获取失败会回退自报值并在理由中注明降级。
body.en: `.probegate.toml` configures uncertainty_threshold, probe, model_target, handoff_mode, api_key and base_url. Defaults are threshold=0.5 and probe=compile. With a key and URL the adapter can fetch a logprob signal; failures fall back to self-report with a degradation marker in the rationale.

note.zh: 四个合成 span 显式给定 0.1/0.9 不确定度和有效/无效 Python，执行真实 compile 探针并检查 AND 判定。不是实际模型置信校准实验。
note.en: Four synthetic spans explicitly supply uncertainty 0.1/0.9 and valid/invalid Python. The real compile probe exercises the AND policy; this is not a live-model calibration experiment.

body.zh: 只有高不确定度且语法失败的组合进入 handoff。
body.en: Only high uncertainty combined with a syntax failure produces handoff.

body.zh: 包支持 Python 3.10+；以下使用 Python 3.12 与 uv。演示不加载端点凭证，也不调用模型。
body.en: The package supports Python 3.10+; these instructions use Python 3.12 and uv. The example loads no endpoint credentials and calls no model.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/probegate.git
cd probegate
uv venv --python 3.12
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .

limitations.zh: 低不确定度且探针失败只会 abstain，不会自动 handoff；该 AND 策略不保证拦下所有错误。
limitations.en: A failed probe with low uncertainty only abstains, without automatic handoff; this AND policy does not catch every error.

limitations.zh: 通过语法检查不代表程序正确，logprob 或自报值也不等于已校准的正确概率。
limitations.en: Passing syntax checks does not establish program correctness; logprobs or self-report do not establish calibrated correctness probabilities.
